tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// dpal chen rta mgrin nag po'i sgrub thabs rgyun khyer de nyid snying po/

sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes gcig bsdus pa/ khams gsum srog la dbang mdzad he ru ka /khro rgyal rta mchog dpal dang drin chen rje// dbyer med skyabs gsum ngo bor phyag btsal nas// rta mchog sgrub pa'i thabs tshul rdo rje'i thog /mi bsrun phye mar 'thag pa'i zab gter sgo// 'byed mdzad mchog sprul rat+na'i dgongs pa bzhin// skal bzang 'gro la phan phyir 'dir gsal bya// de yang skal pa bzang zhing blo gros can// smin byed dbang thob dam tshig mchog la gnas// bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal bar 'dod pa na// thabs tshul 'di la nan tan bya bar rigs// skyabs sems spyi ltar bya/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ chos kun stong nyid snying rje'i rang mdangs las// yongs shar dur khrod rab 'jigs gzhal yas dbus// pad+ma nyi zla klu gnyan sa bdag steng*// rang rig gnam lcags ral gri hrīḥs mtshan pa// de las 'od 'phros 'phags mchod mthu dbang bsdus// dregs pa tshar bcad sems can bde la bkod// tshur 'dus phyag mtshan hrīḥyig yongs gyur las// oṃ ma hā kro dha h+ya grī wa hūm̐ phaṭa: bdag nyid khro rgyal rta mgrin nag po'i sku /mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'jigs pa'i zhal// rab gdangs rno dbal mche ba drag por gtsigs// spyan gsum dmar 'khrug sdang mig glog ltar 'khyug /smin ma ag tshom me yi tshwa tshwa 'phro// lcags ral nag po bskal pa'i mun ltar gtibs// spyi gtsug rta mgo ljang zhur rta skad 'tsher// phyag g.yas gnam lcags 'bar ba'i ral gri 'phyar// g.yon pa lcags kyu zhags pas 'gugs 'ching sdom// dur khrod chas brgyad dar nag ber chen gsol// zhabs gnyis dor stabs bgrad pas sa gsum g.yo// rdo rje'i gad mo drag por sgrog pa yis// 'jig rten dregs pa thams cad dngangs shing 'dar// brgyal zhing myos nas dbang med bran du sdud// dam tshig ye shes gnyis med khro bo'i rgyal// che btsan 'bar ba dpal gyi sku ru gyur// de yi thugs kar rang 'dra'i ye shes pa'i// snying nang nyi steng ral gri hrīḥs mtshan pa// gsal brtan 'bar ba'i mtha' skor sngags phreng rnams// mgal me'i 'khor lo lta bur 'khor ba las// 'od 'phros 'phags mchod mthu dbang byin rlabs bsdus// slar yang 'ur 'ur chem chem 'bar ba'i 'od// drag por 'phros pas gnod byed 'byung po kun// rtsa sbur mes bsregs ji bzhin phye mar byas// snod bcud ye shes sgyu 'dra'i 'khor lor gyur// oṃ hrīḥbadz+ra kro dha h+ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/

thun mthar snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu// rang nyid la thim de yang hrīḥyig la// mi dmigs phyag rgya chen po'i ngo bor thim// hūm̐ hūm̐ spros bral khyab gdal chos kyi dbyings// phaṭa phaṭa snod bcud lha yi ngo bor gyur// dge ba 'di yis mkha' mnyam 'gro ba rnams// gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa'i dri ma kun dag ste// rang rig don gyi khyab bdag he ru ka'i// go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par shog / de ltar dbang chen sgrub pa'i thabs kyi mchog /nyung ngu'i tshig gis chen po'i don ster ba'i// yid bzhin 'di 'dra dad pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser// mchod las dngos grub thams cad 'byung ba yin// de phyir dad dang brtson pa mi g.yel bar// yang dag nyams su len pa'i skal ldan la// phan phyir 'jug bde don kun yongs tshang ba'i// legs bshad pad+ma'i thugs bcud 'di kho na// rmad byung tshul khrims 'dab stong rgyas pa'i rtser// nges gsang sbrang rtsi'i bcud kyis mngar byas pa'i// dpyod ldan dbang rgyal rdo rje'i gsung gi ngor// rdo rje 'dzin pa 'gyur med rdo rjes bris// //
